name: The Chains of Enchantment
source:
You were living a peaceful life with your father, Glen, and your rebellious younger brother, Dean. But all of that is destroyed when you’re attacked by a beautiful, but evil witch known as Ramza! Just when you thought it was the end of the line for you, two handsome agents named Spencer and Bradley come to your rescue! They say they were sent here by the Magical Crime Bureau to protect you and before you have a chance to ask more, you’re taken to Bradley’s mansion!

There you learn that you aren’t related by blood to your father or brother and are actually the heir to the Sinclair family, the magical world’s most powerful and influential family! With magical powers beyond your wildest dreams suddenly at your fingertips, will you be able to conquer Ramza’s organization known as Belladonna? Or will you let your powers consume you...?

The answers lie in the enchanted bonds that you share with your new allies…
translation:
你和你的父亲格伦以及叛逆的弟弟迪恩过着平静的生活。但当你遭到美丽但邪恶的女巫拉姆扎的攻击时，这一切都被摧毁了！就在你以为自己已经完蛋的时候，两位名叫斯宾塞和布拉德利的英俊特工来拯救你了！他们说他们是魔法犯罪局派来保护你的，在你有机会询问更多之前，你就被带到了布拉德利的宅邸！

在那里你了解到，你与你的父亲或兄弟没有血缘关系，实际上是辛克莱家族的继承人，辛克莱家族是魔法世界最强大和最有影响力的家族！超乎你想象的神奇力量突然触手可及，你能征服拉姆扎的颠茄组织吗？或者你会让你的力量吞噬你……？

答案就在于你与新盟友之间的迷人纽带……
